name: Finance Payment Request Follow-Ups
description: A safe external follow-up or settlement decision record. Every invoice is suppressed, exception-bound, or eligible for one owner-approved Stripe resend; a selected received payment is…
audience: Solo entrepreneurs reviewing Stripe invoice follow-ups or reconciling a customer payment already received
problem: A solo operator needs overdue-payment follow-ups and a safe way to reconcile money already received, but a generic reminder or an unverified paid mark can duplicate a payment or misstate what a customer owes.
outcome: A safe external follow-up or settlement decision record. Every invoice is suppressed, exception-bound, or eligible for one owner-approved Stripe resend; a selected received payment is reported/attached or marked paid only with exact evidence, without charging or moving money.
whyAi: An agent can re-check bounded provider lifecycle and received-payment evidence against the external record, leaving collection judgment, allocation choices, customer terms, and material settlement approval with the operator.
operatorPath: Request a collections check for a review window, or report that a customer wired or otherwise paid money directly; the agent resolves the selected external scope, invoice mappings, recent contacts and reminder policy.
Review exceptions, active promises, the independently prepared eligible set, or the exact received-payment match/allocation.
Record an owner approval for the exact resend, PaymentRecord report, payment attachment, or verified full out-of-band settlement action; do not authorize generic autonomous outreach.
agentPath: Read bounded Stripe invoice and invoice-payment lifecycle evidence plus the selected external follow-up or received-payment state.
For a settlement-only occurrence, match one source and allocation, obtain independent review, then report/attach it or mark the exact verified full remaining balance as paid out of band.
Suppress every paid, voided, disputed, paused, corrected, active-promise, mismatch, or unresolved received-payment case before any send action.
Have the control reviewer challenge the eligibility/suppression or settlement decision, then call only the separately owner-gated permitted action.
Write safe outcome and recovery refs to the selected external backend.
recovery: If invoice lifecycle or promise state is incomplete, suppress by default and record an external exception.
If a resend outcome is unknown, retrieve the same invoice and reconcile it; do not use generic communication delivery or a new send path.

If a PaymentRecord report, payment attachment, or paid-out-of-band mark is unknown, re-read the known provider object and selected external record before any retry; never create a new source identity or idempotency key to bypass uncertainty.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop after suppression/eligibility review when no owner resend approval is recorded.
Stop after settlement preparation or review when no matching owner settlement approval is recorded.
Stop with a safe recovery ref when delivery or settlement outcome is uncertain.

handoffs.when: Observed invoice/payment lifecycle or a one-source/one-allocation settlement needs a prepared/unposted external reconciliation entry.
A reviewed follow-up status changes forecast assumptions, or a verified actual receipt needs a once-only external cashflow handoff under the selected policy.

prerequisites: A selected workspace and review window; resolve follow-up rules/history/reminder ownership for followup-only, or the received-payment source/allocation for settlement-only
A separately recorded owner approval for any Stripe invoice resend, PaymentRecord report, payment attachment, or full paid-out-of-band mark
proof: Safe invoice/payment/external-follow-up refs and suppression, settlement, or eligibility state
Control-reviewer, owner approval, source/allocation, and external-record version refs
Action-call and external-write proof refs for any approved settlement or resend
whenToUse: A bounded set of sent/open external invoices needs lifecycle-aware follow-up evaluation.
A customer wired money, paid directly, or paid separately through Stripe and the received payment must be matched to one invoice without charging the customer.

stages.title: Preflight Follow-Up Scope
stages.summary: Resolve the review scope and only the setup applicable to the selected occurrence mode.

stages.title: Read Bounded Invoice Lifecycle
stages.summary: Retrieve only safe Stripe invoice/payment evidence needed to evaluate the external scope.

stages.title: Prepare Received-Payment Settlement
stages.summary: For settlement-only work, read and match one already-received Stripe or direct-bank payment to one invoice without creating a payment or moving money.…

stages.title: Independently Review Settlement Route
stages.summary: Have the control reviewer challenge the current external source, allocation, match, route, and owner approval before a settlement mutation.

stages.title: Apply Owner-Approved Settlement
stages.summary: Run at most the one selected owner-gated Stripe settlement action route and immediately reconcile provider/external state without collecting money.

stages.title: Suppress Ineligible Follow-Ups
stages.summary: Apply required lifecycle and external-state suppression before eligibility is considered.

stages.title: Independently Review Eligible Set
stages.summary: Require the control reviewer to challenge the safe lifecycle/suppression record before an owner chooses an exact resend.

stages.title: Resend Owner-Approved Invoice
stages.summary: Call the exact owner-gated Stripe invoice resend action for an eligible invoice and reconcile its result through invoice reads.

stages.title: Record External Outcome And Handoff
stages.summary: Update only the selected external backend with safe status/proof refs and hand off relevant preparation work.
